description: A report-type deliverable that produces no commits: the harness runs, the Brain's own verification confirms the repository was left exactly as handed over, and the task ends succeeded. Pins the path where a planning task is NOT penalised for changing nothing, which a verifier keyed on 'did anything happen' would get wrong. The harness outcome is scripted (see the corpus README); the acceptance command, the worktree, and the clean-tree check are all real.

contract.title: Draft a migration plan without changing code [[fixture:accepted]]

prompt.objective: Read the repository and produce a written migration plan. Do not modify any files.

acceptance.statement: When the plan-only task finishes, the repository it was handed shall still contain its original README.
